Lawrence Braunstein, who practices law in White Plains, New York, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2007 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Yeshiva University Benjamin N. Cardozo School of Law. He graduated in 1981. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1983.
